attribution: GeoSpec W5b open-arc fixtures: replicad plates, shafts and tubes cut with drawRoundedRectangle, makeCylinder or makeBox, written by replicad's blobSTEP (OCCT STEPControl_Writer).
runtimeDependency: All runtime inputs are files in this directory. The generator locator is attribution only and is never read by the test.
bytePolicy: Byte-locked assets: do not reformat, regenerate, or alter expectations. The STEP headers carry the generation timestamp, so regeneration is not byte-identical.

files.description: Plate 40 x 30 x 5 (makeBox) with a through cutout 20 x 12 whose corners are rounded r = 3 (drawRoundedRectangle extruded and cut): four quarter-turn concave walls.
As a0 with a slot 20 x 6 whose ends are half circles r = 3: two half-turn concave walls meeting the slot's flat sides tangentially.
Shaft r = 10, length 30, with six axial flutes cut by cylinders r = 2 centred on its wall: six concave walls between six exterior cylinder pieces.
Tube r = 15 with a bore r = 6, height 20, slit 2 mm wide through one wall (makeBox cut): the bore wall spans more than half a turn.
As a0 with the rounded cutout 3 mm deep from the top: a blind pocket with four quarter-turn concave corners.
